note: row items spaced by margins instead of gap
row laid out with CSS grid (implicit columns) instead of flexbox
css: .row { display: grid !important; grid-auto-flow: column; grid-template-columns: 24px minmax(0, 1fr); grid-auto-columns: auto; align-items: center; }

note: row titles wrapped in an extra inline span
a chevron inlined as <svg> with stroke=currentColor and the colour on the element
html: <svg class="row-chevron" data-node-id="2:169" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M7.5 15L12.5 10L7.5 5" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.67" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>
css: svg.row-chevron { display: block; flex: none; color: #98a2b3; }

note: literal colours instead of the tokens
padding and radius written as longhands
css: .row { padding: 0 !important; padding-right: 16px !important; padding-left: 20px !important; } .chip { border-radius: 0; border-top-left-radius: 18px; border-top-right-radius: 18px; border-bottom-right-radius: 18px; border-bottom-left-radius: 18px; }

note: an identity transform on the rows (a 2D one: a 3D transform or will-change moves the element to its own layer, which Chromium antialiases differently)
the header's top space as a margin (collapsing through <main>) instead of padding: the same pixels, but the marked element no longer spans the band
